differences.detail: Shared loader hardcodes Difficulty::Fun; host IDs/UI/continue are u8 1..30.
Shared scene rejects special graphics; Web byte allowlist omits VGASPEC. Resource decode/static composition already exists.
Fun01 selected complete attempts and Fun02 entry are prior proof, not 120 solutions or complete DOS internal traces.
DOSBox DBOPL mixer vs Nuked waveform/gain/timbre differ; user listening PASS, no physical-DAC/all-song DOS PCM identity claim.
No new benchmark or optimization claim; check_desktop already uses --fast and disables audio devices.

performance.ci: Reuse three comparable existing logs and profile individual commands once; repeat only as needed, no p95 claim from three runs.
performance.comparison: Same hardware/config, paired alternating baseline/candidate; >10% median or p95 slowdown triggers repeat and investigation, not automatic optimization.
performance.correctness_gate: State/maps/PCM hashes identical for unchanged semantics before considering any speedup.
performance.realtime_gate: Zero missed deadlines/underruns in fixed workload; observed tick/render/audio device quantum budgets, native/browser separately; no universal-device claim.
